captions.detailed: This 3D model features a dual-chamber dropper seatpost assembly consisting of a matte black outer tube and an inner sliding post. At the midpoint of the outer tube is a lever-actuated lockout collar that pivots on a revolute joint, accompanied by a small remote activation cable port on the side. The top of the inner post has a two-bolt saddle clamp head holding a wide, black comfort-shell saddle with silver-colored steel cradle rails, allowing for tilt adjustments on a revolute pivot.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a dual-chamber dropper seatpost. It should feature a large-diameter outer tube, an inner post extending on a prismatic joint, a lockout collar with a pivoting lever, and a saddle clamp head supporting a comfortable black saddle on a tilt-adjustable pivot.
captions.factory: Construct the outer tube using a cylinder primitive with a smaller cylinder subtracted for the cable port. Model the inner post as a narrower concentric cylinder on a prismatic joint. Build the lockout collar and its lever using box and cylinder sweeps, connected via a revolute joint. Form the saddle clamp head with rectangular extrusions and cylindrical bolts, and model the saddle shell and rails using lofted profiles and bent cylindrical sweeps, joined to the clamp head via a tilt-adjusting revolute joint.
